profile_text: With a focus on organizational development and change management, this consulting firm has experienced significant growth, increasing its workforce by 82.1% to 71 employees in 2024. Specializing in helping businesses navigate complex transformations, its expertise is in high demand, driving its expansion as a leading provider of tailored consulting services. As a result, it has earned a "Scaler" category designation, reflecting its rapid and sustained growth in the professional services sector.
